items.title: 6.11.2 Entropy ki qeematon ka muqabla (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.2, printed pages 136-137.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif maddon ki entropies zarraat ki tadaad, tabee khusoosiyat aur halat se muqabla ki ja sakti hain. Zarraat ki kam tadaad ka matlab kam entropy: CaCO3 ki standard entropy (92.9 J fi K fi mol) CaO (39.7) se zyada hai, kyunke zarraat kam hon to mumkin tarteebon ki tadaad kam hai. Milti-julti kimiyai nau'iyat ke maddon mein sakht madde naram se kam entropy rakhte hain: heere ki entropy graphite se kam hai kyunke woh kahin sakht hai, us ki mazboot forces larzish ko mehdood kar ke be-tarteebi ka imkan ghatati hain. Koi madda solid ke taur par liquid ya gas se kam entropy rakhta hai: melting point ke qareeb barf 48.0 J fi K fi mol, pani 69.9, aur boiling point ke theek oopar pani ke bukharat 188.7.

blocks.caption: Standard entropies ka muqabla, J fi K fi mol

blocks.prompt: Entropy ke farq samjhayein: Br2(l) 151.6 banam I2(s) 116.8; H2(g) 130.6 banam CH4(g) 186.2; Hg(l) 76.0 banam Na(s) 51.2; SO2(g) 248.1 banam SO3(l) 95.6 J fi K fi mol.
blocks.explanation: Bromine liquid aur iodine solid hai, to bromine ke molecules zyada azad aur entropy zyada. Methane mein fi molecule paanch atoms hain hydrogen ke do ke muqable, to tarteeb aur energy baantne ke zyada tareeqe. Mercury kamre ke darja hararat par liquid aur sodium solid hai. Sulfur dioxide gas hai jabke sulfur trioxide liquid, aur gases ki entropies sab se zyada hain.

items: Entropy zarraat ki tadaad (CaCO3 92.9 > CaO 39.7), narmi (graphite > heera) aur solid se liquid se gas (barf 48.0, pani 69.9, bukharat 188.7 J fi K fi mol) ke saath barhti hai.
